purpose: Separate source arithmetic, hidden-enemy assumptions and Auto execution failures before changing drafting policy.
eligibility: Both application acknowledgement flags must be true and observed roles, all ordered items and all six choices must deeply equal selected settings. Daily and incomplete application reports are excluded from regular strategy validation. Source hashes preserve provenance.
fixtures: Matches 11, 13 and 15 have paired native recaps with exact end time, rounded signed net worth and stated hero statistics. They are selected uploaded examples from different versions, not a representative PvP sample.
replay: For each fixed own configuration, enumerate all 64 enemy strategies under four modeled role/item-order variants using direct native payloads. Match recaps by outcome, second-rounded end time, 0.1k-rounded signed net worth and all stated fixture hero statistics. Reproduce the saved forecast on its recorded enemy plans to tolerance 1e-8.
informationBoundary: Compatible enemy roles/items/strategy are inferred reconstructions, not directly observed settings. No post-match enemy plan may be used as a pregame feature. Variant counts are deterministic scenarios, not win probabilities.
decision: Source arithmetic must reproduce saved forecasts and compatible outcomes. Record sensitivity separately. No heuristic promotion based on these three examples. Newly supplied completed matches after this benchmark is frozen are reserved for prospective validation; model inputs and criteria remain fixed until that validation is reviewed.
execution: Use an isolated reward-disabled native demo for genuine minimized Chrome from draft start, with unknown scout axes masked only in the test. Require all five roles, 30 item slots, six choices and Continue/match-start acknowledgement. Authenticated PvP and frozen/discarded tabs are outside this browser proof.
